list_sites.title: List my sites
list_sites.description: List every site in the user's Bing Webmaster Tools account with its verification state and the codes (AuthenticationCode, DnsVerificationCode) needed to verify it. Every other tool takes one of these URLs as site_url.

output.description: The sites.

add_site.title: Add a site
add_site.description: Add a site to the user's Bing Webmaster Tools account. It must then be verified (verify_site) using the codes list_sites returns. Adding an already-added site is not an error.

site_url.description: Site URL to add, e.g. https://www.example.com/.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

verify_site.title: Verify a site
verify_site.description: Ask Bing to verify ownership of a site already added with add_site (via the meta tag, XML file or DNS record placed using the codes from list_sites). Returns true when verified.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: True when the site is now verified.

remove_site.title: Remove a site
remove_site.description: Remove a site from the user's Bing Webmaster Tools account, dropping access to its data and settings there.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_site_roles.title: List site users
get_site_roles.description: List the users who have delegated access to a site, with their role (0 Administrator, 1 ReadOnly, 2 ReadWrite), email, and delegation code. Pass an item to remove_site_role to revoke it.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

include_all_subdomains.description: Also include roles on the site's subdomains.

output.description: Role records: Site, Email, Role, DelegatorEmail, DelegatedCode, DelegatedCodeOwnerEmail, VerificationSite, Date, Expired.

add_site_role.title: Give a user access to a site
add_site_role.description: Delegate access to a site (or one of its hosts) to another user by email, as administrator, read-only or read-write.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

delegated_url.description: The site or host to delegate, e.g. https://host1.example.com.

user_email.description: Email of the user receiving access.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

remove_site_role.title: Revoke a user's site access
remove_site_role.description: Revoke a delegated user's access to a site. Pass the role record exactly as get_site_roles returned it.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

site_role.description: One record from get_site_roles, unchanged: {Site, Email, Role, DelegatorEmail, DelegatedCode, DelegatedCodeOwnerEmail, VerificationSite, Date, Expired}.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_site_moves.title: List site moves
get_site_moves.description: List the site moves (domain, host or directory migrations) registered for a site.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Move records: SourceUrl, TargetUrl, MoveScope (0 Domain, 1 Host, 2 Directory), MoveType (0 Local, 1 Global), Date.

submit_site_move.title: Register a site move
submit_site_move.description: Tell Bing a site has moved (after setting up 301 redirects) so it can transfer signals from the source URL to the target URL.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

move_type.description: 0 Local (within your verified sites) or 1 Global.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

submit_url.title: Submit a URL for indexing
submit_url.description: Ask Bing to crawl and index one URL of a site now. Counts against the daily quota (see get_url_submission_quota); for many URLs use submit_url_batch.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

url.description: The page to submit, e.g. https://www.example.com/new-post.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

submit_url_batch.title: Submit URLs for indexing in bulk
submit_url_batch.description: Ask Bing to crawl and index up to 500 URLs of a site in one call, within the remaining daily quota (see get_url_submission_quota).

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_url_submission_quota.title: Get URL submission quota
get_url_submission_quota.description: Read how many URLs the site may still submit today and this month through submit_url / submit_url_batch.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: The quota.

submit_content.title: Push page content to Bing
submit_content.description: Push a page's full HTTP response (status line, headers and body, base64-encoded) directly to Bing so it is indexed without crawling. Counts against get_content_submission_quota; payload up to 10 MB.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

url.description: The page URL the content belongs to.

http_message.description: Base64 of the full HTTP response as Bingbot would see it: status line, headers, blank line, body; lines end with CRLF.

structured_data.description: Base64 structured data (typically JSON-LD) for non-HTML content; empty if none.

dynamic_serving.description: Device this content is served to if the site serves different content per device: 0 none, 1 PC/laptop, 2 mobile, 3 AMP, 4 tablet, 5 non-visual browser.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_content_submission_quota.title: Get content submission quota
get_content_submission_quota.description: Read how many pages the site may still push today and this month through submit_content.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: The quota.

fetch_url.title: Fetch a URL as Bingbot
fetch_url.description: Ask Bingbot to fetch one page of the site now, to check what Bing sees. Read the result later with get_fetched_url_details.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

list_fetched_urls.title: List fetched URLs
list_fetched_urls.description: List the pages fetched with fetch_url and whether each fetch has completed.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Fetch records: Url, Date, Fetched, Expired.

get_fetched_url_details.title: Get a fetched URL's result
get_fetched_url_details.description: Read what Bingbot got when fetching a page with fetch_url: HTTP status, response headers and the document.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: The fetch result.

list_feeds.title: List sitemaps
list_feeds.description: List the top-level sitemaps and feeds submitted for a site, with status, URL count and last crawl. For the children of a sitemap index use get_feed_details.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Feeds: Url, Type, Status, UrlCount, FileSize, Compressed, Submitted, LastCrawled.

get_feed_details.title: Get sitemap index details
get_feed_details.description: List the child sitemaps of a sitemap index, with status and URL count of each.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Child feeds, same shape as list_feeds.

submit_feed.title: Submit a sitemap
submit_feed.description: Submit a sitemap or feed (XML sitemap, RSS 2.0, Atom 0.3/1.0 or text file) for a site.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

remove_feed.title: Remove a sitemap
remove_feed.description: Remove a submitted sitemap or feed from a site.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_rank_and_traffic_stats.title: Get site traffic over time
get_rank_and_traffic_stats.description: Daily impressions and clicks from Bing search for the whole site. Updated daily.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of {Date, Impressions, Clicks}. Dates are WCF /Date(ms)/ strings.

get_query_stats.title: Get top search queries
get_query_stats.description: The site's top search queries with impressions, clicks and average positions. Updated weekly. For one query's pages use get_query_page_stats.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of QueryStats: Query (or page URL), Date, Impressions, Clicks, AvgImpressionPosition, AvgClickPosition. Dates are WCF /Date(ms)/ strings.

get_page_stats.title: Get top pages
get_page_stats.description: The site's top pages in Bing search with impressions, clicks and average positions (the Query field holds the page URL). Updated weekly.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of QueryStats: Query (or page URL), Date, Impressions, Clicks, AvgImpressionPosition, AvgClickPosition. Dates are WCF /Date(ms)/ strings.

get_page_query_stats.title: Get queries for a page
get_page_query_stats.description: The search queries that led to one page, with impressions, clicks and positions.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of QueryStats: Query (or page URL), Date, Impressions, Clicks, AvgImpressionPosition, AvgClickPosition. Dates are WCF /Date(ms)/ strings.

get_query_page_stats.title: Get pages for a query
get_query_page_stats.description: The pages shown for one search query, with impressions, clicks and positions (Query field holds the page URL).

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of QueryStats: Query (or page URL), Date, Impressions, Clicks, AvgImpressionPosition, AvgClickPosition. Dates are WCF /Date(ms)/ strings.

get_query_page_detail_stats.title: Get stats for a query and page
get_query_page_detail_stats.description: Daily impressions, clicks and position for one query on one page.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of {Date, Impressions, Clicks, Position}.

get_query_traffic_stats.title: Get traffic for a query
get_query_traffic_stats.description: Daily impressions and clicks for one of the site's top queries. Updated daily.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of {Date, Impressions, Clicks}. Dates are WCF /Date(ms)/ strings.

get_crawl_stats.title: Get crawl statistics
get_crawl_stats.description: Daily crawl statistics for the last six months: pages crawled, crawl errors, pages in index, inbound links, and counts by HTTP status (2xx, 301, 302, 4xx, 5xx), robots.txt blocks and malware.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Daily CrawlStats rows.

get_crawl_issues.title: Get crawl issues
get_crawl_issues.description: List URLs with crawl issues (Issues is a bit flag set) along with their HTTP code and inbound links. Fixed issues can take days to disappear.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of {Url, HttpCode, Issues, InLinks}.

get_crawl_settings.title: Get crawl settings
get_crawl_settings.description: Read the site's crawl settings: the 24 hourly crawl-rate levels and whether crawl boost is available/enabled.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Crawl settings.

save_crawl_settings.title: Save crawl settings
save_crawl_settings.description: Set the site's hourly crawl rate pattern and crawl boost. Read the current values first with get_crawl_settings.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

crawl_rate.description: 24 hourly crawl-rate levels (1 lowest to 10 highest), hour 0 first, in the site's time zone as shown in Bing Webmaster Tools.

crawl_boost_enabled.description: Turn crawl boost on or off (only if available).

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_url_info.title: Get a URL's index details
get_url_info.description: Read index details for one page or directory: HTTP status, discovery and last-crawl dates, size, anchor count and child URL count. Use the domain: prefix (domain:example.com) for a whole domain.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

url.description: Page or directory URL, e.g. https://www.example.com/blog/ or domain:example.com.

output.description: UrlInfo.

get_children_url_info.title: Get index details for a directory's children
get_children_url_info.description: Page through index details for the pages and subdirectories under a directory, optionally filtered by crawl date, discovery date, doc flags or HTTP code. Read-only. Keep incrementing page until an empty list comes back.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

url.description: Directory URL, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com/blog/.

crawl_date_filter.description: Crawled within: 0 any, 1 last week, 2 last two weeks, 4 last three weeks.

discovered_date_filter.description: Discovered within: 0 any, 1 last week, 2 last month.

doc_flags_filters.description: Bit flags: 0 any, 1 blocked by robots.txt, 2 malware.

output.description: UrlInfo rows, as in get_url_info.

get_url_traffic_info.title: Get a URL's search traffic
get_url_traffic_info.description: Impressions and clicks from Bing search for one page or directory (domain:example.com for a whole domain).

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: UrlTrafficInfo.

get_children_url_traffic_info.title: Get search traffic for a directory's children
get_children_url_traffic_info.description: Page through impressions and clicks for the pages and subdirectories under a directory.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: UrlTrafficInfo rows.

get_link_counts.title: List pages with inbound links
get_link_counts.description: Page through the site's pages that have inbound links, with the link count for each. TotalPages says how many pages to request.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Link counts.

get_url_links.title: List inbound links to a page
get_url_links.description: Page through the external pages linking to one page of the site, with their anchor text.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

link.description: The site's page URL to get inbound links for.

output.description: Link details.

get_connected_pages.title: List connected pages
get_connected_pages.description: List the external pages (e.g. social profiles) registered as connected to the site.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Connected pages.

add_connected_page.title: Add a connected page
add_connected_page.description: Register an external page that links to the site (e.g. its social profile) as connected to it.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

master_url.description: URL of the external page that links to the site.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_keyword.title: Get keyword impressions
get_keyword.description: Bing search impressions for a keyword over a date range (exact and broad match). Not tied to a site. For weekly history use get_keyword_stats; for ideas use get_related_keywords.

country.description: Country/region code, e.g. us, gb; empty for all.

language.description: Language-market code, e.g. en-US; empty for all.

output.description: The keyword.

get_keyword_stats.title: Get keyword history
get_keyword_stats.description: Historical Bing search impressions for a keyword, one row per period (exact and broad match). Not tied to a site.

country.description: Country/region code, e.g. us, gb; empty for all.

language.description: Language-market code, e.g. en-US; empty for all.

output.description: Rows of {Query, Date, Impressions, BroadImpressions}.

get_related_keywords.title: Get related keywords
get_related_keywords.description: Keywords related to a seed keyword with their Bing impressions over a date range — for keyword research. Not tied to a site.

country.description: Country/region code, e.g. us, gb; empty for all.

language.description: Language-market code, e.g. en-US; empty for all.

output.description: Rows of {Query, Impressions, BroadImpressions}.

list_blocked_urls.title: List blocked URLs
list_blocked_urls.description: List the pages and directories blocked from Bing search results for a site, with block type and expiry.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of {Url, EntityType (0 page, 1 directory), RequestType (0 cache only, 1 full removal), Date, DaysToExpire}.

add_blocked_url.title: Block a URL from Bing results
add_blocked_url.description: Temporarily block a page or directory from Bing search results (or just its cached copy). Blocks expire; see list_blocked_urls.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

url.description: Page or directory URL to block/unblock.

request_type.description: 0 remove only the cached copy, 1 remove from search results entirely.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

remove_blocked_url.title: Unblock a URL
remove_blocked_url.description: Lift a block placed with add_blocked_url. Pass the same url, entity_type and request_type the block has in list_blocked_urls.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

url.description: Page or directory URL to block/unblock.

request_type.description: 0 remove only the cached copy, 1 remove from search results entirely.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_active_page_preview_blocks.title: List page preview blocks
get_active_page_preview_blocks.description: List the site's pages whose rich previews (snippets) in Bing results are currently blocked.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Page preview block records.

remove_page_preview_block.title: Remove a page preview block
remove_page_preview_block.description: Allow Bing to show a rich preview for a page again.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_deep_link_blocks.title: List deep link blocks
get_deep_link_blocks.description: List the sitelinks (deep links) blocked from appearing under the site's results, per market and search URL.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Deep link block records: Market, SearchUrl, DeepLinkUrl.

add_deep_link_block.title: Block a deep link
add_deep_link_block.description: Stop Bing from showing a specific sitelink (deep link) under a result URL in a market.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

search_url.description: The result URL the sitelink appears under.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

remove_deep_link_block.title: Unblock a deep link
remove_deep_link_block.description: Allow a sitelink blocked with add_deep_link_block to appear again.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

search_url.description: The result URL the sitelink appears under.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

list_query_parameters.title: List URL normalization parameters
list_query_parameters.description: List the query-string parameters Bing ignores when normalizing the site's URLs (e.g. session ids), and whether each is enabled.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of {Parameter, IsEnabled, Source, Date}.

add_query_parameter.title: Add a URL normalization parameter
add_query_parameter.description: Tell Bing to ignore a query-string parameter (e.g. sessionid) when deduplicating the site's URLs. Only letters and ':' are allowed; the number per site is limited.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

set_query_parameter_enabled.title: Enable or disable a URL parameter
set_query_parameter_enabled.description: Turn an existing URL normalization parameter on or off without removing it.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

is_enabled.description: True to enable, false to disable.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

remove_query_parameter.title: Remove a URL normalization parameter
remove_query_parameter.description: Stop Bing ignoring a query-string parameter for the site.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

get_country_region_settings.title: List geo-targeting settings
get_country_region_settings.description: List the country/region targets set for the site or its pages, directories, domains and subdomains.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

output.description: Rows of {Url, TwoLetterIsoCountryCode, Type (0 page, 1 directory, 2 domain, 3 subdomain), Date}.

add_country_region_settings.title: Add a geo-target
add_country_region_settings.description: Tell Bing that a page, directory, domain or subdomain targets a particular country/region.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

url.description: The page, directory, domain or subdomain being targeted.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US.

type.description: What url is: 0 page, 1 directory, 2 domain, 3 subdomain.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.

remove_country_region_settings.title: Remove a geo-target
remove_country_region_settings.description: Remove a country/region target set with add_country_region_settings; pass the same values it has in get_country_region_settings.

site_url.description: The verified site as registered in Bing Webmaster Tools, e.g. https://www.example.com/ (from list_sites).

url.description: The page, directory, domain or subdomain being targeted.

country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US.

type.description: What url is: 0 page, 1 directory, 2 domain, 3 subdomain.

output.description: Nothing useful: `d` is null on success; a failure comes back as an API error.
